expected_text:
Learning to swim as an adult has been slower than I expected. The movements make sense when the instructor explains them but in the water I seem to forget everything at once. Last week I managed a full length without stopping and felt proud for the rest of the day.

expected_text:
The museum was much smaller than the guidebook suggested. We went through the main rooms in less than an hour but stayed longer in the room of ordinary household objects. There was a kettle like the one my aunt used and a tin full of buttons that reminded me of her sewing cupboard.

On the train home I kept thinking about that room. The famous paintings were impressive but those familiar objects had brought back details I had not remembered for years including the sound of the cupboard door.
